omissions.go/deepseek-flash: Served by the Go service and named by no route row on either page; models.dev carries no entry for it either, so neither a wire nor its limits can be derived.
omissions.go/glm-5: Served by Go and no longer routed by the Go page, which routes GLM 5.1, 5.2, 5.3 and 5.3 Flash. The Zen page still routes this id, and one service's route is not the other's, so none is taken from it.
omissions.go/grok-4.5: Served by Go and absent from the Go page, which routes Grok 4.6. models.dev states an npm package for it, and that field is deliberately not used as a route, so none is carried.
omissions.go/hy3-preview: Served by Go and named by no route row on either page; models.dev carries no entry for it, so neither a wire nor its limits can be derived.
omissions.go/kimi-k2.5: Served by Go and absent from the Go page, which routes Kimi K2.6, K2.7 Code and K3. The Zen page still routes this id, and one service's route is not the other's, so none is taken from it.
omissions.go/mimo-v2-omni: Served by Go and absent from the Go page, which routes MiMo V2.5 and V2.5 Pro. models.dev states a name and limits for it and no wire, so none is carried.
omissions.go/mimo-v2-pro: Served by Go and absent from the Go page, which routes MiMo V2.5 and V2.5 Pro. models.dev states a name and limits for it and no wire, so none is carried.
omissions.go/minimax-m2.5: Superseded on Go by MiniMax M2.7 and M3, which are both carried. The page still lists it.
omissions.go/omen-alpha: Served by Go and no longer routed by the Go page, which is why this release dropped it from the catalogue. No source states a wire for it any more, so a caller that needs it must name the protocol itself.
omissions.go/qwen3.5-plus: Served by Go and absent from the Go page, which routes Qwen 3.6 Plus and later. The Zen page routes this id on Messages, and one service's route is not the other's, so none is taken from it.
omissions.zen/claude-sonnet-4: Served by Zen and named by no route row on either page: the Zen page routes Claude Sonnet 4.5 and 4.6. models.dev states an npm package for it, and that field is deliberately not used as a route, so none is carried.
omissions.zen/deepseek-v4-flash-free: Served by Zen and absent from the Zen page, which routes DeepSeek V4 Flash. models.dev states a name and limits for this free id and no wire, so none is carried.
omissions.zen/glm-5: Superseded by GLM 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3, which are all carried. The page still lists it.
omissions.zen/gpt-5-codex: Superseded Codex generation; gpt-5.3-codex and gpt-5.3-codex-spark are carried.

omissions.zen/gpt-5.2-codex: Superseded Codex generation; gpt-5.3-codex and gpt-5.3-codex-spark are carried.
omissions.zen/kimi-k2.5: Superseded by Kimi K2.6, K2.7 Code and K3, which are all carried.
omissions.zen/minimax-m2.5: Superseded by MiniMax M2.7 and M3, which are both carried.
omissions.zen/muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free: Served by Zen under an id no page routes: the Zen page's free-model list names the 1.3 contributor model, and Go's 1.2 contributor row is a different id on the other service. models.dev states an npm package for it, and that field is deliberately not used as a route, so none is carried.
